evals.prompt: /seditor map login, password reset and 2FA flows
evals.expected_output: One valid logic schema and same-basename HTML path launcher in SEditor/; run the validator and explain backend launch.
assertions: Schema validates as SEditor v1
Launcher is same-basename and references ../<slug>.json
Launcher contains no schema JSON snapshot
User is told how to launch local backend

evals.prompt: Нарисуй карту экранов приложения и переходов между ними
evals.expected_output: A designer schema that describes discovered screens and transitions plus its launcher.
assertions: Inspects project routes/UI before drafting
Writes a designer-*.json and paired .html
Validates the schema

evals.prompt: My team needs a visual map of the API modules and which services call each other.
evals.expected_output: A code architecture schema based on the existing project.
assertions: Recognizes the request as a schema request
Uses repository evidence instead of inventing modules
Writes matching JSON/HTML pair

evals.expected_output: Ask which schema type/topic to produce and do not create files yet.
assertions: Asks one clear type/topic question
Creates no speculative schema or launcher

evals.prompt: Create a data model for this project; SEditor/data-model.json already exists and has manual edits.
evals.expected_output: Ask before overwriting the existing schema or select a new non-conflicting slug.
assertions: Does not overwrite existing JSON or launcher without permission
Keeps the existing editor bundle intact

evals.prompt: Update the existing logic diagram to include account lockout after 5 failed attempts.
evals.expected_output: Update the JSON in place; its existing HTML launcher continues pointing to that path.
assertions: Updates existing schema rather than silently changing slug
Does not embed a JSON snapshot or regenerate launcher for content-only edit
Validates the edited schema

evals.prompt: Add a deployment schema to a project whose SEditor/app/version.json differs from the skill bundle.
evals.expected_output: Synchronize the bundled editor files as one version before creating the launcher.
assertions: Detects manifest/version mismatch
Updates the coherent editor bundle
Creates path-based launcher and validates result

evals.prompt: Fix the mobile CSS layout in index.html; do not create a diagram.
evals.expected_output: Handle as a normal UI fix, not a schema-generation task.
assertions: Does not generate a schema or launcher
